name: agent-sessions
description: Share coding-agent sessions with your team through the git repo you already work in.

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Share coding-agent sessions through git. /sessions:push commits a handoff summary plus a redacted transcript under .claude/sessions/ on your branch; /sessions:pull loads teammates' sessions (from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini CLI) into your chat; /sessions:init prepares a repo.
